scientific.integrity: The primary full text was inspected at the model equations, feasible region, reproduction number, local and global disease-free theorems, and conclusion. The critical proof is analytic; the checker only verifies algebraic identities. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The result is for the source feasible region and the disease-free threshold \(\mathcal R_0\le1\). It does not settle the endemic-equilibrium global stability problem or give a sharp critical decay rate.

title: A critical-threshold Lyapunov identity closes the waning-immunity SARS-CoV-2 disease-free theorem
